verified.independentReviewGate: All20 expected IDs, distinct author/reviewer, exact lesson/question/source hashes, source/answer/choices/hints/explanation/revealFlag checks, official answer and no unresolved issues required.
verified.publicationBoundary: Only registered fully reviewed batches compose current annual lesson sources and bank. build-content.py and apply-hints.py reject direct unregistered modifications.
verified.versions: Only changed lessons get baselineVersion+1; keep lessons retain old versions; repeated accept is byte-stable in isolated tests.
verified.legacyReviews: Old data/lesson-reviews are byte-preserved and validate against archived lessons for registered revisions. No H1=false policy assertion remains.
verified.historicalPreservation: The original 2021 historical integration assertions remain tied to its completed historical commit; current workspace additionally validated by quality gates.
verified.classificationCompatibility: Old classification source hashes are accepted only for registered IDs, equal immutable baseline full-question hashes, after exact canonical validation of the complete current bank/lesson composition. The helper runs once per compile_learning_tools call, not once per classification item.
verified.historicalCrossQualificationProof: FP PR49 historical AP manifest proof compares to the pinned baseline AP manifest SHA380df4bc18e06903077a76b8630263479c965f86ce087938593352d3d09c9c6e after current AP quality validation. AB manifest current hash remains strict. Mobile classification and transcription terminal-version proofs use the immutable baseline while current source fields and original images remain checked.
verified.draftCI: check-drafts checks all40 assignments/800 envelopes and any submitted review hashes without promoting unregistered material or claiming content approval.

resolvedFindings.description: The initial validator did not compare current source-crops.json with its pinned baseline, allowing sourceRectangle edits whenid/page/image remained unchanged.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Author added byte equality checks for current answer-keys.json, sources.json and source-crops.json against immutable archive. Added fixture coverage and sourceRectangle mutation rejection test.

resolvedFindings.description: Python structural equality treated an original answer integer1 as equal to JSONtrue. In an isolated registeredq14 fixture the old classification hash was accepted and the builder also accepted a boolean answer, while JSvalidChoiceFormat requires an integer.
resolvedFindings.reproduction: /workspace/scratch/ap-a-quality/probe-classification-types.py initially demonstrated acceptance; shared source files were never mutated.
resolvedFindings.resolution: validate_workspace now compares canonical SHA256 for current lesson composition and complete bank against expected values, preserving JSON types. Registered answer1-to-true regression test now rejects the mutation before classification fallback.

limitations: Pilot linguistic/factual approval is provided by separate content reviewers, not this code review.

The new browser test code was reviewed for isolated synthetic guest records, all20/60hints/80reasons, offline, legacy snapshots and record restoration, but I did not execute it; the integration owner executes and records browser/publication checks.

integrationAdjustments.description: Classification baseline compatibility limited to independently registered lesson-only revisions; old classification JSON and review files remain unchanged. Tests cover approved change, wrong hash, unregistered text, original stem and boolean-answer changes.
